text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While on the move with Calstone Light O, I 
spotted two people who caught my 
attention...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright Ruby, see you later. ...Just 
please, don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for concern. Please 
excuse me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Did something happen?
Are you okay? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, no. Sorry, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's just, it looked like Ruby wanted to 
say something... If you don't want me 
prying, though, okay."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm kinda curious. I'll go check it out 
for a second.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Miracle was worried about you. Are you 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There is no need for concern.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is there something you want to say to 
Miracle-san?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure I understand what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I really can't stop thinking about it. I 
was so distracted I couldn't even focus in 
class."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Are you dissatisfied with Miracle-san, by 
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If you don't tell me clearly, I won't 
understand. I don't think Miracle-san 
understands either. We're worried 
precisely because we don't understand.
choice_data_list: True, that might be the case.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Here. It is a gift from a certain 
foundation.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Is that... a pair of invitation tickets? 
'Acoustic Charity Concert'?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've heard they play popular tunes 
and nursery rhymes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe this will suit her tastes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However, it takes place tonight. It would 
be impolite to extend such a sudden 
invitati—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: We'd better hurry then!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"—So with that in mind, are you free 
tonight?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm...! So that's it... That's what 
was going on, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby. I'm free tonight.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That's great. Then we can go together.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry about me. On such short 
notice—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What does it matter if it's sudden? 
Miracle-san said she's free.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah. I'd really like to go. ...Is 
that okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you, both of you. Shall we go 
then, Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Yes. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their figures faded into the distance. It 
seems the matter is settled.
choice_data_list: I'm glad we were able to give them a push.
I'm glad we were able to give them a push.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their figures faded into the distance. It 
seems the matter is settled.
choice_data_list: I'm glad we were able to give them a push.
I'm glad we were able to give them a push.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, being straightforward is best for 
everything. Those two are always taking 
the scenic route.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even though we're right in front of each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Huh? My back? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I was just curious.
